pages.raw_title: About Gabelli: A Global Investment Firm Overview - Gabelli
pages.raw_meta: Explore About Gabelli, a global investment firm focused on exceptional client experiences and superior investment results.
raw_blocks: Gabelli is a global investment firm. Its mission is to deliver superior results and an exceptional client experience.

We offer an array of investment choices across funds (Open and Closed-End) and separate accounts. Today, we combine research with our accumulated, compounded knowledge to craft our value, growth, fixed-income, and convertibles strategies.
The Gabelli Research Process rests solidly on three pillars:
The Gabelli Equity Research Team includes over 30 sector-focused analysts who support equity portfolio management and provide sector insights to all investment disciplines.

Our trademarked Private Market Value (PMV) With a Catalyst™ approach utilizes fundamental, bottom-up research to identify companies selling at less than their intrinsic value. Our ability to identify mispriced companies with strong business fundamentals and the presence of a catalyst that will surface value underscores our ability to deliver superior absolute returns.
Our proprietary research process begins with an examination of a company’s intrinsic value. From our universe of over 2000 companies, we invest in companies as owners of those businesses.
Research, relationships, and results are inextricably linked. We forge strong ties with clients, provide exceptional experiences, and deliver long-term results.
Our bottom-up research methodology informs every investment strategy, enabling us to uncover hidden value and deliver superior returns.
We create trust and build long-term client partnerships by aligning our solutions with each client’s unique needs.
We deliver time-tested money-making solutions, offering tailored strategies through various investment vehicles.
Your Goals are our Goals
The only outcomes that matter to us are yours. If you’re looking for ideas, we’d love to share ours with you.
who we do it for

Institutional and individual clients have entrusted Gabelli with their assets for nearly five decades. We join our investors’ unique needs with Gabelli’s trademarked investment approach into bespoke strategies. We aim to earn a superior absolute return for our clients.

We provide institutional clients with tailored strategies to generate long-term growth. Our research-driven approach ensures we can navigate complex market environments, helping institutions confidently achieve investment objectives.

For high-net-worth individuals and families, we offer personalized wealth management services. We aim to preserve and grow wealth, support their financial goals, and create a lasting legacy for future generations.

We partner with investment professionals to deliver innovative strategies aligned with their client’s needs. By leveraging our proprietary research and investment insights, we help advisors enhance their offerings and achieve superior outcomes for their clients.

For nearly 50 years, Mario Gabelli has driven our commitment to helping clients achieve their financial aspirations. As a pioneer of value investing, Mario Gabelli founded Gabelli with a clear purpose: to leverage rigorous research to generate superior returns. His innovative strategies and commitment to excellence have defined Gabelli as an investment leader known for integrity, performance, and the ability to navigate the complexities of the financial markets. Under Mario’s leadership, Gabelli continues to refine its proprietary research methodologies to consistently deliver strong, risk-adjusted returns and build an unparalleled reputation with clients and investors.
The Gabelli Discipline is reflected across all of our investment products. Our diverse strategies are offered through an array of products to meet every investor’s needs.
Stay informed with the latest news, insightful research, and expert perspectives tailored for forward-thinking investors straight from our Gabelli research desks.
